style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a brushed steel surface in a control room, extreme asymmetry with heavy negative space left. A precision-machined, deep pine green modular block with distinct separated internal channels is shown being mechanically compressed into a flat, generic bone white slab with no delineations. hard clean edges, one stark directional light from the top right throwing a long cast shadow. graphite and slate grey background. matte muted palette, no text, no molded lettering.

core_conflict: structural role boundaries vs flattened text representation
